newsitem.title: USA: Microdyne exits networking, sees charge.
newsitem.headline: Microdyne exits networking, sees charge.

text.p: Microdyne Corp said Monday it will exit the networking products business and record a third quarter charge of between $5 to $8 million to cover expected losses and closing costs.

Microdyne said its networking products division, which makes network connectivity products, incurred substantial losses over the past eighteen months. The company said it is seeking a buyer for the division and also is exploring a sale of the division's product lines individually.

"We have not been able to compete effectively in the market, nor to achieve sustainable profitability at the division even following the restructuring of the division earlier this year," Microdyne said in a statement.

The Virginia-based diversified manufacturing, technology, and services company said it will concentrate on its two other divisions -- Aerospace Telemetry and Microdyne Support Services -- both of which it said "are well positioned to continue current growth and profitability."
